title: Mercury Gemini Apollo Resource Reel 1  SILENT
description: Untitled 01:00:15 – Mercury Program astronauts: Original Seven astronauts at press conference, in classroom training, in front of  fighter jet and ingressing/egressing aircraft, planes taxi; desert survival training; zero-g training, MASTIF (?) trainer. 01:07:19 – Mercury Program spacecraft: workers assembling spacecraft, moving spacecraft into hangar, Grissom, Glen, Shepard checking out interior controls. 01:08:57 – Astronauts getting off an airplane, nice closeups while on runway.  Cut to group touring Cape.  Astronauts water skiing,  01:10:00 – Workers lowering Mercury capsule from transport vehicle. 01:10:11 – Shepard suiting up, breakfast, medical check. 01:10:38 – MR-3 on launchpad, Shepard arrives and goes up elevator; MR on pad, liftoff and ascent, in-cabin view of Shepard, Shepard on deck of recovery vessel. 01:13:46 - Parsley glider 01:14:02 – Gilruth talking with Grissom, other astronauts in hospital room, MR-4 Grissom suits up, launchpad at night, McDonnell closeout crew sealing capsule door, liftoff, people watching. 01:15:23 – Holiday Inn sign: Hope and Prayers of Free World are with Col John Glenn; Glenn eating breakfast, suiting up, people at Cape ready to watch launch, Glenn boarding transfer van, ingressing capsule, teenagers in convertible and others on beach watching launch, Mercury Control Center tracking chart and countdown clock; Shepard in control room; MA-6 liftoff and track ascent; people on beach watching; Glenn inside Capsule, MCC tracking map with capsule cutout on screen, recovery ship, parade at Cocoa Beach, Kennedy and Glenn give speeches at welcome event. 01:23:57 – Scenes from MA-7, 8 and 9: Cooper suits up, brief shot in MCC, MA-? liftoff and ascent, people watching, Schirra onboard film, Earth view, capsule in water with recovery ship approaching, Carpenter on deck of ship greeted, and arriving at Grand Turk medical center.  01:25:14 – Gemini Program: new astronaut class touring Cape, Armstrong and ? and other new recruits during interview (?), medical checks, classroom training. 01:27:41 – Gemini capsules on factory floor in scaffolding at McDonnell, workers working on hatch, etc., closeup of model. 01:28:24 – astronauts water survival, parachute, capsule egress training. 01:28:57 – Gemini 3 launch, capsule in water, closeups of Grissom and Young as they are hoisted to helicopter, arrive on recovery ship, event with LBJ, ticker tape parade in NYC with Humphry. 01:30:23 – crew training – ingress capsule, centrifuge, Ed White wearing EMU training for EVA on air bearing floor, Gemini 4 onboard film: EVA, MCC, McDivitt and White at event college campus, receive medals from LBJ and Humphry. 01:32:58 – Titan erected from horizontal to vertical, sunset, crew walking out of building, ingress transfer van, ingress Gemini spacecraft, closeout crew seals hatch, launchpad, TV crews, liftoff and ascent, people on beach watching,  01:36:03 - onboard film: Gemini 6 and 7 views of each other during rendezvous. 01:37:10 – Gemini launch, onboard film during rendezvous, Gemini 7 capsule and crew floating in water during recovery, Borman and Lovell getting off helicopter onto deck of ship, greeted at airport. 01:38:33 – Gemini 8 crew Armstrong and Scott posing in flight suits, arriving at launchpad, ingressing capsule, Titan launch, onboard views of Agena. 01:39:23 – Gemini 9 Stafford and Cernan exiting a building, arrival at launchpad, launch, on-orbit views of ATDA. 01:40:28 – Gemini 10 crew Young and Collins suiting up, Collins training for EVA on air bearing floor, launch, in-cabin on-orbit views, Agena target, Collins’ or possibly Gemini 11 EVA. 01:41:55 – Gemini 12 Aldrin checking capsule, crew arrival at pad, Walter Cronkite and other newscasters, launch, on-orbit views of Agena, Aldrin’s EVAs. 01:43:51 – Apollo Program: Astronauts meeting at Spacecraft Checkout Facility; astronauts scuba diving; survival and parachute training; geology field trip; classroom training with large globe. 01:45:58 - Apollo 1 crew Grissom, Chaffee and White suited for test. 01:46:16 – Saturn 1B Launch Area – Saturn 1B on launchpad.  Crew ingresses capsule. 01:46:40 – Apollo 4 and/or AS-202 launch views of stage separation and view out window. 01:51:39 – Apollo 8 crew Borman, Anders and Lovell posing in suits, centrifuge test, Saturn on launchpad, crew suit up, launch, onboard in-cabin views, lunar surface, Earth still image, crew arrival on recovery ship, parade in Houston. 01:54:32 – Apollo launch, Apollo 9 crew McDivitt, Scott and Schweickart in-cabin on-orbit.  Views of CM and LM during Earth orbit undock/dock exercise, Schweickart EVA, parachute deploy during re-entry. 01:59:10 – LM ground tests, dropped from crane (Langley?) 01:59:40 – Apollo 10 Cernan, Young and Stafford in-cabin views, Earth rise over moon, lunar surface, transposition and dock views, views of CM and LM during lunar orbital rendezvous OPS.
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
